item.title: Dibrugarh Advises Board Exam Students to Start Early on February 14 Due to PM Modi’s Moran Visit
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Dibrugarh district administration has issued an advisory for students appearing in the HSLC and Higher Secondary examinations on February 14 in view of Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s visit to Moran the same day. The Prime Minister is scheduled to attend the inauguration of the Emergency Landing Facility at Moran, an event expected to draw a large gathering and lead to traffic regulations in and around the venue. item.description: GUWAHATI: The Guwahati Cine Club, founded in 1965, will host the 18th International Guwahati Film Festival from February 13 to 17 at the Kanaklal Baruah Auditorium of the Assam State Museum in Ambari. item.title: Bridge Over Lohit River Connecting Majuli and Lakhimpur Districts Inaugurated, Other Infrastructure Projects Unveiled
item.description: GUWAHATI: A 702-metre-long bridge over the Lohit river at Dhunaguri, Majuli, was inaugurated with the aim of improving connectivity between the districts of Majuli and Lakhimpur.
